theorem_results.pairwise_affine_fiber: For every distinct a,b in GF(2)^2 there is a one-bit linear functional whose target fiber is exactly {a,b}.
theorem_results.pairwise_optimum: mu_ab=min(m_a,m_b) is deterministic polynomial via nonnegative odd/even simple-path optimization.
theorem_results.target_collapse: R_c=max_{d!=c}mu_cd equals m_c unless c is the unique strict maximum label cost.
theorem_results.global_exception_bound: At most one of the four label classes can have m_c > M where M=max_{a<b}mu_ab.
theorem_results.witness_ceiling: Exact value collapse does not by itself reconstruct a prescribed-label optimal witness.
